title: Polynomial-Augmented Neural Networks (PANNs) with Weak Orthogonality Constraints for Enhanced Function and PDE Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2406.02336v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present polynomial-augmented neural networks (PANNs), a novel machine learning architecture that combines deep neural networks (DNNs) with polynomial expansions. PANNs combine the strengths of DNNs (flexibility and efficiency in higher-dimensional approximation) with those of polynomial approximation (rapid convergence rates for smooth functions). To aid in both stable training and enhanced accuracy over a variety of problems, we present (1) a family of orthogonality constraints that impose mutual orthogonality between the polynomial and the DNN within a PANN; (2) a simple basis pruning approach to combat the curse of dimensionality introduced by the polynomial component; and (3) an adaptation of a polynomial preconditioning strategy to both DNNs and polynomials. translated_title: 多项式增强神经网络（PANNs）及其弱正交约束用于增强函数和偏微分方程逼近
translated_abstract: arXiv:2406.02336v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们提出了多项式增强神经网络（PANNs），一种结合深度神经网络（DNNs）与多项式展开的新型机器学习架构。PANNs结合了DNNs（在高维逼近中的灵活性和效率）和多项式逼近（对光滑函数的快速收敛速率）的优势。为了在各种问题中促进稳定训练并提高精度，我们提出了：（1）一组正交性约束，在PANN中强制多项式与DNN之间相互正交；（2）一种简单的基剪枝方法，以应对多项式分量带来的维度灾难；（3）将多项式预处理策略适应于DNNs和多项式。我们测试了所得架构的多项式复现特性、逼近光滑函数和有限光滑性函数的能力，并作为偏微分方程（PDE）求解器。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合深度神经网络与多项式展开的新架构PANNs，通过引入正交性约束、基剪枝和预处理策略，显著提升了函数和偏微分方程逼近的精度与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PANNs, a novel architecture combining deep neural networks with polynomial expansions, enhanced by orthogonality constraints, basis pruning, and preconditioning to improve accuracy and stability in function and PDE approximation.
